title: trichilia brasiensis
intro: Trichilia brasiensis, commonly known as Brazilian cherry or Amazon cherry, is a plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Trichilia brasiensis include treating wounds, fever, and digestive issues, as well as providing relief from pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
